market_notes:
These are asking prices seen in search snippets, not transaction prices.

RX 350 AWD (Chicago)
- CarGurus: about 200-214 RX 350 AWD listings near Chicago, $3,900-$63,995. The average is about $12,376 in one snapshot and $11,823 in another. About 75-78% show no reported accidents.
- 2011 RX 350: Edmunds average list $13,315, average mileage 124,962, average trade-in $5,764.
- 2012 RX 350: Edmunds average list $13,979, average mileage 113,837, average trade-in $6,874. CarGurus shows 56 2012 RX listings at $10,154-$24,695. The Cars.com nationwide average is $12,947, from $7,950.
- 2013 RX: CarGurus average $14,224 (73 listings, $10,329-$22,998). Edmunds 2013 RX 350 Chicago average $15,198. CARFAX 2013 RX range $11,344-$18,299, average $14,750.
- Cars.com shows 28 RX 350s under $15k near Chicago.
- KBB snippet for a 2012 RX 350: resale value $11,400, trade-in $8,575. This is useful for estimating the Aug-2027 sale value.
- Realistic RX AWD bands under $13.5k:
  - 2010-2011 with 100-120k miles: $12,800-$13,500 (Top Gear 2011, 114k, $12,800; Palatine 2010, 97k, $13,490).
  - 2012-2013 with 130-145k miles: $11,000-$13,800 (Libertyville 2012, 144k, about $11,160; Chicago 2013, 132k, $13,795 Great Deal).
  - 170-196k miles: $9,000-$11,000.

ES 350
- 2011 ES 350 in Chicago: average list $12,478-$13,931 depending on source, range $5,995-$14,995, average mileage about 101-115k, trade-in about $7,403.
- 2012 ES on CarGurus: 40 listings, $6,059-$23,719, average $12,212.
- 2013 ES 350 Chicago average $15,348. 2014 ES 350 national average $16,775.
- Cars.com shows 11 ES 350s under $10k near Chicago.
- Newer-generation (2013-2014) ES 350s with about 140-145k miles do appear at $11,995-$12,595 from independents in Des Plaines and Joliet.
- 2010-2012 ES with 150k+ miles run $8,800-$10,000 (Lansing Great Deal $8,812; Top Gear 2010, $9,945).

ES 300h
- Chicago averages: 2013 $15,378 (107,946 miles), 2014 $17,404, 2015 $19,566.
- The only concrete one found was a 2013 at Woodfield Lexus: $16,373 with 133,977 miles.
- Under $13.5k is essentially unavailable in the Chicago dealer market.

CT 200h
- iSeeCars Chicago: 17 cars from $9,985. 2012s run $9,985-$15,785 (102-173k miles); 2013s run $13,888-$20,995.
- Addison independents list 2013-2014 CTs with about 120-125k miles at $10,945-$12,600. A 2017 CT with 180k miles in Waukegan lists at $8,707.
- Several CT VINs showed prior accidents or conflicting mileage, so check Carfax.

IS 250 AWD and GX 470
- 2014-2015 IS 250 averages about $19.4-19.6k in Chicago, which is out of budget. The in-budget cars are 2006-2010 AWD units (2006, 140k miles, $7,835) or RWD outliers (Revved 2015 RWD, $11,250).
- GX 470 under the cap only exists with very high miles (2005, 267k, $12,800). A 2006 with 137k miles is $22,377.

Deal patterns
- Addison IL independents (Top Gear Motors, Revved Motors) hold several older Lexus at $9.9k-$13.9k with VDPs.
- Luxury AutoMaXX in Tinley Park carries about 196k-mile RX units at $9k-$12.7k.
- Lexus franchise stores (Naperville, Woodfield, Fields Glenview) price older trade-ins at $14k+.
- Private Craigslist posts (for example a 2012 ES350 with 86k miles at $10,995 in Bartlett) are the likeliest real bargains, but their dates could not be verified.
- Carvana and CarMax listings seen were above budget (Carvana 2011 RX with 77k miles at $17,990; CarMax Kenosha 2012 CT with 60k miles at $22,998).
search_coverage:
I used all 93 WebSearch calls, the full cap. WebFetch and curl were not used.

What I searched:
- Aggregator city pages: CarGurus, Cars.com, Edmunds, TrueCar, iSeeCars, Carsforsale and CarMax for RX 350 AWD, ES 350, CT 200h and ES 300h around Chicago. These mostly returned counts and averages, plus a few individual snippets.
- VIN-prefix queries: 2T2BK1BA (RX AWD) by year and by suburb, JTHBK1EG and JTHBK1GG (ES 350), JTHKD5BH (CT 200h), JTHBW1GG (ES 300h), JTHCK262 and JTHCF1D2 (IS 250 AWD) and JTJBT20X (GX 470). This was the most productive method.
- About 20 full-VIN lookups to confirm price, mileage and dealer.
- Dealer-domain searches:
  - chicagomotorcars.com: only a sold 2013 RX.
  - Autobarn and Castle: the search returned an unrelated auto-parts site (autobarn.com).
  - luxuryautoselection.com: no prices.
  - Fields Lexus Glenview, Lexus of Highland Park, Lincolnwood and Westmont: no under-budget prices.
  - McGrath, Woodfield and Lexus of Orland: no prices.
  - topgearchicago.com: productive, 5 VDPs.
  - revvedmotors.com: productive.
  - luxuryautomaxx.com: productive.
  - globalautosales.us: productive.
  - Jennings VW, AutoNation Libertyville, Prince Auto Sales, Toyota on Western and Northside Toyota: no specific prices.
- Craigslist Chicago and Milwaukee search pages for RX, ES and CT (3 searches). These gave prices, but post dates and mileage were mostly unknown.
- Kenosha and Racine searches (3). These found the Waukegan RX and a CarMax Kenosha CT, which was over budget.

What failed:
- Car Outlet, Castle Motor Sales, Autos of Chicago, Sunrise, Bill Jacobs, Ideal, DriveNow, Glenview Luxury and Northwest Auto: I could not surface their inventory, or had no searches left to try.
- CarMax Schaumburg, Naperville and Countryside pages returned no individual prices.
- Search summaries sometimes mixed up data. VIN conflicts (Palatine 2010 RX, Addison CT $10,945) and price or mileage conflicts (Tinley 2013 RX, Cicero 2012 RX, JTHKD5BH6E2175070, JTHKD5BH0B2036404) are recorded in red_flags.
- No listing dates were visible for any dealer listing.

market_notes:
These are asking-price averages from Edmunds, Cars.com and CarGurus summaries (what the search engine reported, not verified).

ES 350:
- 2011 in Milwaukee: average $10,004 at 136,469 mi.
- 2012 in Milwaukee: average $14,354 at 117,135 mi.
- 2011 in Chicago: average $13,931 at 101,010 mi.
- 2012 in Naperville: average $13,146 at 111,173 mi.
- 2013 in Chicago: average $15,348 at 105,506 mi.
- 2014 near Milwaukee: 40 listings, average $14,995.
- Edmunds value ranges: 2010 $1,765-$7,957; 2012 $4,066-$10,617.
- Nationwide averages (Cars.com): 2010 $9,600-$10,064; 2011 $11,965.

RX 350:
- 2010 in Milwaukee: average $13,200 at 125,854 mi.
- 2011 in Chicago: average $13,315 at 124,962 mi.
- 2012 in Chicago: average $13,979.
- Nationwide averages: 2011 $12,157; 2012 $12,947.
- Edmunds 2011 value range: $2,557-$11,049. A clean 2011 is worth about $5,602 as a trade-in and about $7,526 in a private sale.
- 28 RX 350s are listed in Wisconsin on Carsforsale, the cheapest at $9,399.

CT 200h:
- 2013 in Chicago: average $13,926 at 115,442 mi, average trade-in $5,146.
- 2014 in Chicago: average $15,286 at 100,367 mi, average trade-in $8,202.
- 2015 nationwide: average $13,097.
- Edmunds 2013 value range: $4,233-$8,968.
- The cheapest CT on Carsforsale Wisconsin is $10,195.

ES 300h:
- 2013 in Chicago: average $15,378 at 107,946 mi.
- 2014 in Chicago: average $17,404 at 101,874 mi.
- KBB private-party value for a 2013: $11,260-$14,460.
- None was found under $13.5k. The only one seen was a 2015 at Car City, Palatine: $16,490 with 125,612 mi (VIN JTHBW1GG6F2080805).

IS 250:

- Edmunds value ranges: 2010 $2,249-$5,690; 2011 $3,063-$9,487.

- Mt Pleasant/Milwaukee: 2013 RX 350 AWD, $15,812, 124,724 mi (VIN 2T2BK1BA5DC199732).

- Waukegan: GX 470, $15,999.

- Schoepp Motors (Middleton): no Lexus under $17.5k. It listed a 2019 RX 350L AWD at $17,500 with 36k mi, which looks like a data error.

Leads without a price:
- Chicago-area ES 350s rated by CarGurus:
  - Naperville: 2012, 72,339 mi, Good Deal.
  - Schaumburg: 2010, 150,660 mi, Great Deal.
  - Elmhurst: 2011, 130,038 mi, Good Deal.
  - Morton Grove: 2012, 124,068 mi, Fair Deal.
- Crystal Lake: 2011 CT 200h, 181,638 mi (VIN JTHKD5BH0B2038007).
- Planet Cars Exchange: 2011 IS 250 AWD, 140,129 mi.
- Premier Auto Works: 2011 IS 250 AWD.
- Racine: 2010 IS 250 AWD, 93,958 mi.
- Madison area: 2012 IS 350 AWD, 148,371 mi.
- Smart Budget Cars (Madison): has an RX 350 page and a 2012 GX 460 VDP, but no prices were shown.
- Mad Motors (Madison): also carries GX 470, IS 250 and RX 400h.

Patterns:
1. The CT 200h has the deepest supply of priced units under $13.5k. There are several 2014-2015 cars at $10.9k-$12.6k with 78-125k mi, and they have the lowest fuel cost of the Lexus options.
2. RX 350 AWD units at or under $13.5k are either 2010-2012 cars with 160-210k mi, or 2013 cars priced right at the cap. A 2012-2013 RX with about 120k mi usually asks $13.8k-$16k.
3. Independent lots (Mad Motors, Ramsey, Route 41, Integrity) hold the sub-$10k ES 350 and GX 470 units, but the summaries rarely show their year and miles.
4. The 2014-2015 CT 200h appears to be the best value. For example, Fine Auto Sales (Cudahy) lists a 2015 with 78k mi for $11,995, but it has an insurance-loss flag. The German Auto House 2012 CT at $7,872 is the cheapest entry, but it has 181k mi.
5. For Aug 2027 resale (estimate): these cars would carry about 9k more miles and be one model year older. Trade-in values in the summaries run $5-8k for 2011-2014 CT/RX/ES, so expect a meaningful dealer-to-trade-in spread. Selling privately would recover more.
search_coverage:
I ran 95 WebSearch calls, which is the full cap, and no fetches.

- Aggregator city pages (Edmunds, Cars.com, CarGurus, TrueCar, Autotrader, KBB, iSeeCars, Autolist) for Madison, Milwaukee, Chicago, Rockford, Naperville, Schaumburg and Palatine returned mostly counts and averages.
- Carsforsale.com state and city pages worked better. They surfaced Meeker Hill, Integrity Motors and the West Bend ES from $9,800.
- Dealer domains searched: madmotorsofmadison.com, ramseymotors.net, smarttoyota.com, smartbudgetcars.com, meekerhillauto.com, acurabrookfield.com, luxcarschicago.com, luxuryautoselection.com and schoeppmotors.com. I also ran one combined search across russdarrow, zimbrick, kayser, boucher, ewald, heiser and internationalautos, and another across the Bergstrom sites, Lexus of Milwaukee and Lexus of Brookfield.
- VIN-prefix queries worked best, especially with phrases like 'priced' and 'miles away from <city>'. I used JTHKD5BH, 2T2BK1BA, JTHBK1EG, JTHBK1GG, JTHBW1GG, JTHCF5C2, JTJBT20X, and 2T2BC1BA/JTJBC1BA. They produced most of the priced listings.
- Full-VIN lookups often returned history-report spam and no price. Searching exact 'price + mileage + city' strings worked better for finding the dealer name.

What failed:
- No prices for the Zimbrick 2012 RX VDP, Lux Cars, Mad Motors or Ramsey individual units, or the Chicago ES 350 deal-rated units.
- Auto Selection Madison was not found under that name.
- Kayser, Capitol Auto, Don Miller, Enterprise Car Sales, CarMax Madison/Milwaukee, Golden Cars and Icon Motors were not searched individually because of the cap.
- Green Bay, Oshkosh, La Crosse and Dubuque coverage is thin: only Bergstrom Appleton and Integrity in Fond du Lac.
- No private-party listings from Facebook or Craigslist surfaced.
- The ES 300h search found nothing under budget.
